title: Hindsight Bias Through Knowledge Updating: A Conceptual Replication of Groß et al. (2023)
overview: Preregistered online experiment (4 groups x OJ/ROJ/NJ tasks) on hindsight bias and knowledge updating for the sugar content of food items; N = 300 analysed.

studies.title: Preregistered online experiment: hindsight bias and transfer learning for the sugar content of food items
studies.description: Single empirical study (N = 300 analysed) with a 3 (task: OJ, ROJ, NJ) by 4 (group: control, feedback, domain information, irrelevant information) mixed design. Appendices B (priors), C (mapping knowledge) and D (anchoring) are further analyses of the same sample, not separate experiments.

readiness.note: Blocked only by the missing filler text of the control group (issue iss_filler). The feedback, domain and irrelevant arms can run once the researcher accepts the open decisions.
